newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita sets up TV joint venture in India.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita sets up TV joint venture in India.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said on Monday that it set up a joint venture in India with a local enterprise, Salora International Ltd, on December 1 for making colour televisions and audio equipment.
The new firm, Matsushita Television & Audio India Ltd, is capitalized at one billion ruppee (about $28 million), and 55 percent held by Matsushita and the rest by the Indian company.
The firm is expected to produce 240,000 colour television sets, 90,000 radio casset players and 80,000 mini-component stereo systems in 1997, Matsushita said in a statement.
